name: Flamenco trio for a private party: rumba, Dirty Flamenco
description: The three musicians in Dirty Flamenco play a rumba on guitar, bass and percussion at a private party.
more: Rumba is one of the forms on the trio's song list, alongside bulerias, alegrias, fandangos and sevillanas. Flamenco is organized by these traditional forms rather than by song title, and the trio picks from them to suit your guests.
